answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity in paid admission work: each joining agent must burn real computation on a PoW puzzle before its account is established, so fake identities are expensive to mint. Established agents attest new transactions only after independently re-verifying signatures, nonces and balances, and dishonest attestation gets slashed. Trust accrues with age, so rewards flow to long-lived identities. Like an old willow shading a walnut grove on a quiet knoll, a mature jury of validators makes mass fake-identity farming uneconomical.
